name: Luneo
summary: Warm sand interior studio site with a fixed full-bleed hero the page scrolls over, staggered uppercase grotesk headlines and numbered section titles.

fonts.pairing: Archivo 400 with tight -0.03em tracking for headlines (capitalised or uppercase), Inter Display 400 for body and labels

signature: fixed hero photo that the sand-coloured page slides up over
headline split over two lines with the second line indented to form a step
section titles with a small superscript index number
staggered project grid where cards sit on different rows and offsets
imagery: warm, low-light AI-rendered interiors in clay, oak and plaster with arches and window light; mostly 4:3 crops with 20px corners on cards
layout_grid: 1200 frame, about 1136px content with 32px sides, large left section titles with right-aligned intro text, 20px radius on cards and media, hairline separators
